course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Strengthen sentence stress when contrasting what is true and not true.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A misunderstanding about a booking, delivery, or appointment needs to be corrected clearly.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Correcting information with contrast and clear emphasis.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik correct a mistaken detail about a booking or delivery by contrasting the wrong information with the accurate information.

main_focus.name: contrastive correction with inte... utan...
main_focus.description: Use a clear contrast frame that supports sentence stress and makes corrections easier to hear.
model_examples: Tiden är inte på torsdag utan på fredag.
Det gäller inte leveransen utan återbetalningen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use inte... utan... naturally 3-4 times, with the corrected information placed clearly after utan.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use correction vocabulary and contrast chunks to make the accurate detail easy to identify.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker repeats a detail that is not quite right.
dialogue_shape.middle: They correct the information using contrastive phrasing and check that the new detail is understood.
dialogue_shape.ending: They restate the correct detail and explain the practical consequence.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat the contrast frame in several practical corrections

focus: the incorrect detail that is corrected
the contrast between the wrong and accurate information
the practical consequence of the correction

sentence_focus: one sentence with inte... utan about a date
one sentence with inte... utan about a place
one sentence restating the accurate detail
one sentence explaining what changes because of the correction
